# AGOT: The Long Night & Azor Ahai -- THE 1.0.12a RESTORE.
#
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GENERATED FILE. Do not hand-edit -- regenerate with ln-audit-tools/gen_dragon_restore.py.
# Last regenerated against AGOT 0.5.1, which added 13 genes and retuned 1,608 of 3,960 values.
# Source: common/scripted_effects/00_agot_scenario_dragons_effects.txt (agot_historical_dragons_setup),
# 72 dragons, 3960 curated gene values, read verbatim.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS. 1.0.12 shipped a sweep over historical dragons' storage entries which stripped every gene variable
# from historical dragons' storage entries in the belief that those entries were blank by design. They are not:
# agot_historical_dragon_transfer_vars_to_story_cycle_effect writes ~40 curated values straight onto the story
# (00_agot_dragon_effects.txt:2302). The entry is the ONLY place a historical dragon's canonical appearance
# lives, and we deleted it. Balerion, Caraxes, Vermithor and every other named dragon turned white in every
# running save. The full post-mortem is the headstone comment in zz_ln_ice_dragon_effects.txt.
#
# WHY IT CANNOT SIMPLY RE-RUN THEIR SETUP. agot_historical_dragons_setup is called from `on_game_start`, which
# fires on a NEW GAME only -- never on a save load -- and every branch of it runs
# agot_historical_dragon_transfer_vars_to_story_cycle_effect, which opens with `create_story` and spawns a
# dummy character. Calling it on a save that already has entries would leave every named dragon with two
# stories and a stray corpse. So this file does the one safe thing instead: it writes the same numbers onto the
# entry that ALREADY EXISTS, with set_variable and nothing else. No story is created. No character is spawned.
#
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ⚠ THE UNDEAD GUARD -- Thomas caught this before it shipped, and he was right to ask.
#
#   "What happens if the dragon gets taken by the Night King? That's when the colour of their skin is actually
#    supposed to change. Is it going to accidentally 'fix' them as well?"
#
# It would have. `ln_apply_the_cold_effect` (zz_ln_ice_dragon_effects.txt:454) sets EIGHT genes -- primary and
# secondary hue/value, eye, horn -- and `gene_dragon_body_shading_value` is NOT one of them. That is precisely
# the marker this file gates on. So a historical dragon raised by the Others, whose entry lacks that one
# variable, would have matched the limit and been repainted in its LIVING colours: Caraxes red again, on the
# Night King's side. The repair would have quietly undone the mod's own centrepiece.
#
# Hence the second condition on every branch below. An undead dragon is never restored, whatever its entry
# looks like -- the cold is the correct appearance for it and this file has no business touching it.
#
# THE GENERAL LESSON, and it is the same one that caused the original bug: a repair keyed on the ABSENCE of a
# value must enumerate every legitimate reason that value could be absent. "Blank" is not a synonym for
# "broken."
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# THE GATE IS THE DEFECT, NOT THE VERSION. Each dragon is repaired only if its entry has actually lost
# gene_dragon_body_shading_value. A save that never ran 1.0.12, or that has already been repaired, matches
# nothing and pays one list walk.
#
# SELF-EXTINGUISHING. Once every entry is whole the limit is false for all 72 dragons and this costs a single
# walk of a tens-of-entries global list, once a year, forever.

ln_restore_historical_dragon_looks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			agot_has_dragon_storage_system_global_list = yes
			# ── THE EARLY-OUT, AND IT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ONE LIST WALK A YEAR AND SEVENTY-THREE ──
			# Thomas's standing rule: "for all of our self-heal stuff, make sure that it's not performance
			# heavy." Without this line a HEALTHY save still runs all 72 branches every year, each opening
			# its own every_in_global_list and finding nothing -- 72 walks to do no work. With it, a healthy
			# save pays exactly one walk and stops. A damaged save pays 73 once and is then healthy.
			# any_in_global_list verified in AGOT's own 00_agot_canon_dragons_triggers.txt:630.
			any_in_global_list = {
				variable = gl_dragon_variable_storage
				NOT = { has_variable = gene_dragon_body_shading_value }
			}

		}

		# -- viserion --
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = character:dragon_viserion
				# Never repaint one of theirs. See the undead-guard note in the header.
				character:dragon_viserion = { NOT = { has_trait = ln_undead_dragon } }
			}
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = gl_dragon_variable_storage
				limit = {
					var:dragon_id ?= character:dragon_viserion
					NOT = { has_variable = gene_dragon_body_shading_value }
